answer: Bind each agent identity to a hardware root of trust: a TPM chip signs an attestation proving the agent runs on real silicon, not a script farm. (1) New agents register their TPM public key and stake 200 tokens. (2) Each epoch the registry re-attests a random 5%; failures slash the stake and freeze the identity for 30 epochs. (3) A forged identity needs a fresh TPM chip, about $45 each, so 1,000 puppets cost $45,000 in hardware plus 200,000 tokens locked. The kernel of trust is the chip itself, and a fake signal dies at the forge, like a locksmith who checks the metal itself.
